text.body:
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān kapilavastuni mahānagare viharati sma nyagrodhārāme |
atha vāsiṣṭho mahābrāhmaṇo bhagavataḥ purāṇo gṛhasakho divā vihāram anucaṅkramann anuvicaran yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagavatā sārdhaṃ [16\verso] saṃmukhaṃ saṃrañjanīṃ saṃmodanīṃ vividhāṃ kathāṃ vyatisāryaikānte niṣaṇṇaḥ | ekāntaniṣaṇṇaṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ viditvā bhagavān idam avocat |
kena tvaṃ vāsiṣṭha evaṃkṛśo vivarṇo dīrghaśmaśrukeśanakharomārūkṣakāyaḥ kṣāmasvarabhāṣī |
vāsiṣṭha āha | māsopavāsair ahaṃ bho gautama evaṃkṛśo vivarṇo dīrghaśmaśrukeśanakharomārūkṣakāyaḥ kṣāmasvarabhāṣī |
atha khalu bhagavān jānann eva vāsiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paryapṛcchata | upavasasi tvaṃ vāsiṣṭhāryāṣṭāsamanvāgatam upavāsaṃ prati jāgarṣi prātihārakaṃ pakṣam |
vāsiṣṭha āha | kiṃ tasya bho gautama bhavati ya āryāṣṭāṅgasamanvāgatam upavāsam upavasati pratijāgarti prātihārakaṃ pakṣam |
bhagavān āha | bhuṅkte sa vāsiṣṭha kāmān divyān mānuṣyakāṃś ca |
vāsiṣṭha āha | sa ced gautama ime śā[17\recto from CUL 131.5]lā āryāṣṭāṅgasamanvāgatam upavāsam upavāseyuḥ pratijāgṛyuḥ prātihārakapakṣam | ete 'pi bhuñjīran kāmān divyān mānuṣyakāṃś ca |
bhagavān āha | asthānam etad vāsiṣṭha anavakāśo yad ime śālā bhāṣitasyārtham ājñāsyanti nedaṃ sthānaṃ vidyate | api tu māṇaka asthānaṃ nigamayyasya parikalpam upādāya vakṣyāmi | ime cen mama śālā bhāṣitasyārtham ajānīyur ete 'pi bhuñjīran kāmān divyān mānuṣyakāṃś ca |
vāsiṣṭha āha | katham upoṣite bho gautama āryāṣṭāṅgasamanvāgata upavāse bhuṅkte kāmān divyān mānuṣyakāṃś ca |
bhagavān āha | iha vāsiṣṭha śrāddhaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā | āryāṣṭāṅgasamanvāgatam upavāsam upavasitukāmaḥ kalyam evotthāya śravaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vā anyatamaṃ vā vijñapuruṣam upasaṃkramya ekāṃ samuttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā [17\verso] dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtāñjalipuṭa evaṃ bhāṣate |
yathā te āryā arhanto yāvajjīvaṃ prāṇātipātaṃ prahāya prāṇātipātāt prativiratā nihatadaṇḍā nihataśastrā lajjino dayāvantaḥ sarvasattvaprāṇibhūteṣv antaśaḥ kuntapippalikām api prāṇinam upādāya | evam evāham evaṃnāmā imāṃ velām upādāya yāvac ca rātrir āgāminī yāvac ca śvaḥ sūryodayo 'trāntare prāṇātipātaṃ prahāya prāṇātipātāt prativiramāmi |
anenāhaṃ prathamenāṅgena teṣām āryāṇām arhatāṃ śikṣām anuśikṣe anuvidhīye anukaromi ||
yathā te āryā arhanto yāvajjīvam adattādānam abrahmacaryaṃ mṛṣāvādaṃ surāmaireyamadyapramādasthānaṃ nṛtyagītavāditamālāgandhavilepanabhūṣaṇavarṇaka[18\recto]dhāraṇam uccaśayanamahāśayanam akālabhojanaṃ prahāyākālabhojanāt prativiratā evam evāham evaṃnāma imāṃ velām upādāya yāvac ca rātrir āgāminī yāvac ca śvaḥ sūryodayo 'trāntare 'dattādānam
abrahmacaryaṃ mṛṣāvādaṃ surāmaireyamadyapramādasthānaṃ nṛttagītavāditamālāgandhavilepanavibhūṣaṇavarṇakadhāraṇam uccaśayanamahāśayanam akālabhojanaṃ ca prahāyākālabhojanāt prativiramāmi | anenāham aṣṭamenāṅgena teṣām āryāṇām arhatāṃ śikṣām anuśikṣe 'nuvidhīye anukaromi |
evaṃ dvir api trir api |
ayam ucyate māṇava āryāṣṭāṅgasamanvāgata upavāsaḥ | evam upoṣita āryāṣṭāṅgasamanvāgata upavāso mahāphalo bhavati mahānuśaṃsaḥ | amṛtaṅgamo 'mṛtaparyavasāno 'mṛtaphalasākṣātkriyāyai samvartate | eva[18\verso]m āryāṣṭāṅgopavāsam upoṣya bhuṅkte kāmān divyān mānuṣyakāṃś ca |
evaṃ vāsiṣṭha āryāṣṭāṅgasamanvāgatam upavāsam upavasitasya śrāddhasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhitur vā na śakyaṃ puṇyasya pramāṇam udgrahītum | etāvat puṇyaphalaṃ vā puṇyaphalavipāko vā | api tu bahutvāt puṇyasya mahān puṇyaskandha iti saṃkhyāṃ gacchati |
tadyathāpi nāma vāsiṣṭha yatremāḥ pañca mahānadyaḥ sambhedasamavasaraṇaṃ gacchati | tadyathā gaṅgā yamunā sarayūḥ sindhur vakṣuś ca | tatra na śakyam udakasya pramāṇam udgrahītuṃ etāvad udakaṃ vā udakakumbhaṃ vā udakakumbhaśatāni vā udakakumbhaśatasahasrāṇi vā | api tu bahutvād udakasya mahān udakaskandha iti saṃkhyāṃ gacchati |
tat kiṃ manyase vāsiṣṭha kaścit śaknuyān mahāsamudrodakasya pramāṇam udgrahītum | etāvad udakaṃ vā u-
